# framework test create

Treat the user input as a complete feature description. Analyze the existing
project and create a feature-level test plan at `test_plan_path`, a quality
checklist at `checklist_path`, plus every relevant test needed to express the
behavior. Use the detected stack and existing conventions. Keep behavior tests
red, do not implement production code, and report every changed test path.
